description: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist. The #1 Agent Skills library for science, used by 250,000+ scientists worldwide. 177 ready-to-use validated skills plus 100+ scientific databases covering biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. Compatible with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Antigravity, and the open Agent Skills standard.
vibe: Ship only what the agent loads, validate everything, and never let a skill smuggle in a test or a secret.
highlights: Strict scope policing: general software-engineering, infrastructure-with-a-science-example, and orchestrator skills are routinely declined to protect selection quality.
Closed frontmatter contract: only six fields allowed, block-style YAML required because strictyaml rejects JSON flow style and takes name/description down with it.
Hard separation of concerns: tests and diagrams never live under skills/, tests anchor via explicit path resolution, and one skill per pytest process to avoid _common module collisions.
Version discipline: metadata.version must be bumped in the same change, and plugin.json version must stay identical to pyproject.toml.
Security scanning with documented false-positive triage: verify findings against the code before 'fixing' them.
assessment: This file treats the skill directory as a runtime artifact with a strict load contract, not a general-purpose repo folder, which is exactly the right mental model for agent-consumed content. The explicit enumeration of validator failure modes (flow-style YAML, top-level Hermes keys, JSON-string manifest blocks) shows hard-won operational knowledge rather than aspirational style. The one-skill-per-process rule and the _common.py collision story are the kind of concrete, non-obvious constraint that separates a real engineering document from boilerplate.
